title: Automated Lead Engine
audience: Freelancers and solo agencies with a proven campaign that want unattended processing without a custom application.
shortDescription: Deploy an unattended prospecting pipeline with n8n, current website evidence, OpenAI, and Hunter or Apollo.
coreOutcome: Connect the pipeline and let the system do the repetitive work.
problem: A proven campaign still consumes time when every lead must be moved through each processing step manually.
situation: Your qualification method works and volume now justifies connected workflow automation.
commonFailure: A linear happy-path workflow fails without deduplication, stop states, retries, cost controls, and dry runs.
methodology: Connect discovery, normalization, evidence, structured qualification, enrichment, outreach, sequence state, and exception handling.
whoItsFor: Operators with a proven campaign and intermediate automation skills
whoItsNotFor: Beginners who have not validated their campaign or teams needing production application architecture
stateModel: Google Sheets is primary state; workflow is the unit of execution
supervision: Unattended processing with monitoring and exception review
technicalBoundary: n8n is the primary orchestrator; workflow logic owns retries and dedupe. It is not a database-backed custom application.
